n3400413123.headline: Nikos Androulakis: A Bill to Regulate Private Debt and Support Small and Medium Businesses Is Coming
n3400413123.summary: Greek opposition leader Nikos Androulakis said a bill to regulate private debt and support small and medium-sized businesses is coming. He argued that many productive businesses struggle to meet their obligations.
